create_LinearW24_layer: create a LinearW24 sparse linear layer with 2:4 sparsity support for a neural network
replace_linears_with_sparse_linear: replace all nn.Linear layers matching a filter function with LinearW24 sparse layers in a module
update_24sparsity_enable: enable 2:4 sparsity on all LinearW24 layers in a model and reset torch compilation caches
update_24sparsity_disable: disable 2:4 sparsity on all LinearW24 layers in a model and reset torch compilation caches
review_LinearW24_forward: review the LinearW24 forward pass that sparsifies weights using xformers sparsify24 with STE gradient
